first_owner_risk: an episode is at risk when at least one withheld follower stands on its ordered destination objective at the side's first-ever play-stage ownership of it, after the episode start
own_ground_unit: own operator of the infantry or vehicle type (artillery included) with a readable hex; passengers are not operators
s25_categories_first_match: ordered at one decision from different hexes
same hex, different first route hexes
baseline-v2 did not emit the same MOVEs
trigger holds at a valid first divergence
trigger holds after a divergence or without prefix support

s25_intersection.scope: descriptive only; a mismatch voids the intersection, not the study

shadow.chain_order: free-flow arrival, route cost, route length, unit id (experiments/t9_batch.path_times, the unit's type and move_state, basic_speed, the setup cost graph)
shadow.group_trigger: eligible movers grouped by current hex and route first hex; a group of at least minimum_group movers with at least one threat-exposed member starts an episode
shadow.one_episode_per_unit: a member of an active episode cannot join another; after completion each member is spent at the shared start hex until observed on another hex
shadow.release: the next pending member is released when the reference unit (initially the leader) is absent or observed on a readable hex other than the shared start hex; a released member with a baseline-v2 MOVE becomes the reference
shadow.threat: Sprint 18's threat-exposed order predicate: a visible enemy operator of any class with a published direct-fire range against the mover's type covers the mover's hex or one of the first route_prefix_hexes route hexes (distance at most the range)
shadow.wait_bound: every pending member is released when the reference has not left and cur_step - reference release step > stall_factor * reference hex time + stall_slack (the PS-1 stall definition)

A.rule: met when any registered HH side-game has fewer episodes than the minimum (episodes counted over every recorded decision, under the frozen state machine), or when the HH side-games are not all present

B.rule: met when fewer distinct H0 scenario-sides than the minimum have an episode

C.rule: over the H0 and HH episodes, replicas de-duplicated (an identical episode counts once, and is at risk if at risk in any replica): met when there is no episode, or when twice the first-owner-risk episodes exceed the episodes (strictly more than one half)
